rules.bet_down_to_rule: bet only if your book's price is at or better than BET DOWN TO
rules.listed_rule: actionable alt rungs are listed at the named book at the named price; unlisted or unverified rungs are research-only
rules.ladder_rule: a book's alternate rungs count as listed only when the whole ladder is consistent with that book's own two-sided line (every lower rung at least as likely, every higher rung at most as likely, within 3 pts) and never rises with the line; otherwise the ladder is unverified and research-only
rules.decision_rule: Sunday early / late games: the first pull at or after 9:23 AM Pacific; TNF, SNF, MNF, London and Saturday games: the last pull before the kickoff cutoff
